constraints.source_text: Students are required to complete 46 units for the major, including 32 units of required core courses.
constraints.description: The major requires 46 total units, of which 32 units must be required core courses.
constraints.note: Treated as a category split between core and remaining major units; catalogue does not explicitly bound the remainder.

constraints.source_text:

JOUR 206 Reporting and Writing Practicum Units: 1 (2 units required)
JOUR 207 Reporting and Writing I Units: 4
constraints.description: Students must complete JOUR 201, JOUR 206 (2 units required), and JOUR 207 as lower-division required courses.

- JOUR 300 Journalism and Society Units: 4
